about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Gobi Pakora
recipes.summary: Cauliflower florets in a spiced chickpea-flour batter, shallow-fried until crisp.
steps: Whisk the besan, cumin, turmeric, chilli, salt and water into a thick batter that coats a spoon.
Steam the cauliflower for 3 minutes, drain well and toss through the batter.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat until a drop of batter sizzles straight away.
Fry the florets in 3 batches for 3 to 4 minutes, turning, until deep golden and crisp, then drain on paper towel.
Squeeze over the lemon juice and serve hot while the crust is crisp.
notes: Snack. Vegan. Per serving: about 8 pieces.

recipes.title: Chilli Lime Corn Ribs
recipes.summary: Roasted corn cobs cut into curled strips, glazed with smoky butter and finished with lime.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C fan (240°C conventional). Cut each cob in half crosswise, then stand upright and slice each half into 4 long wedges.
Toss the wedges with the butter, paprika, chilli and salt.
Spread on a lined tray cut side up and roast for 30 minutes, turning once, until the kernels are golden and the edges curl.
Squeeze over the lime juice and scatter with the coriander.
Eat warm, holding the ribs by the cob.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 1 cob.

recipes.title: Potato Bhajia
recipes.summary: Thin potato slices in a turmeric and chilli batter, shallow-fried and served with a tomato chilli dip.
steps: Whisk the besan, water, turmeric, cumin, chilli and salt into a batter the thickness of pouring cream.
Dip the potato slices into the batter so they are fully coated.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat and fry the slices in batches for 3 minutes each side until golden and the potato is tender.
Drain the bhajia on paper towel and keep them in a single layer so they stay crisp.
Mix the tomato sauce with the lemon juice and serve alongside while the bhajia are hot.
notes: Snack. Vegan. Per serving: 6 to 8 slices.

recipes.title: Baked Tequenos
recipes.summary: Cheese-filled pastry sticks, a Venezuelan party snack, baked until crisp and gooey inside.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C fan (220°C conventional). Cut each pastry sheet into 6 strips.
Wrap one strip around each cheese stick in a spiral, pinching the ends so the cheese cannot leak.
Brush with the egg, scatter with sesame seeds and place on a lined tray.
Bake for 20 minutes until deep golden and puffed.
Warm the tomato sauce with the chilli and serve for dipping.
notes: Snack. Per serving: 2 tequenos.
Food safety: wash hands after handling raw egg.

recipes.title: Hong Kong Egg Tarts
recipes.summary: Flaky shortcrust tartlets filled with a smooth, lightly sweet egg custard.
steps: Rub the butter into the flour and icing sugar, add the yolk and cold water, and bring together into a dough. Chill for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 180°C fan (200°C conventional). Roll the dough thinly, cut 8 rounds and press into a greased 8-hole muffin tin.
Stir the caster sugar into the hot water until dissolved and cool for 10 minutes, then whisk in the eggs and milk and strain.
Pour into the pastry cases and bake for 25 minutes until the custard is set with a slight wobble and the pastry golden.
Cool for 15 minutes before lifting out of the tin.
notes: Plus 30 minutes chilling.
Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 1 tart.
Food safety: bake the custard until set, wash hands after handling raw egg, and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Lokma Honey Doughnut Bites
recipes.summary: Crisp-outside, soft-inside Turkish dough balls soaked in a honey and lemon syrup.
steps: Whisk the flour, yeast, sugar and salt with the warm water into a loose, sticky batter. Cover and prove for 1 hour until bubbly.
Simmer the honey, the 1/4 cup water and lemon juice for 5 minutes until syrupy and keep warm.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat. Drop in teaspoons of batter and fry for 3 to 4 minutes, turning, until golden and puffed.
Drain briefly, then roll in the warm syrup until glossy.
Serve at once so they stay crisp.
notes: Plus 1 hour proving.
Snack. Vegan. Per serving: 5 bites.

recipes.title: Alfajores with Caramel Filling
recipes.summary: Tender cornflour shortbread sandwiches filled with thick caramel and rolled in coconut.
steps: Simmer the condensed milk in a saucepan over medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring constantly, until thick and caramel coloured. Cool.
Heat the oven to 160°C fan (180°C conventional). Beat the butter and icing sugar until pale, then beat in the yolks.
Fold in the cornflour, flours and baking powder, roll to 5mm and cut 16 rounds with a 5cm cutter.
Bake for 12 minutes until set but still pale. Cool completely.
Sandwich pairs with caramel and roll the edges in the coconut.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 2 alfajores.
Food safety: wash hands after handling raw egg yolks.

recipes.title: Welsh Cakes
recipes.summary: Small spiced griddle cakes studded with sultanas, cooked in a dry pan.
steps: Rub the butter into the flour until it looks like breadcrumbs, then stir in the sugar, sultanas and spice.
Mix in the egg and milk to make a soft dough, and roll to 1cm thick.
Cut 12 rounds with a 6cm cutter.
Cook in a dry non-stick pan over medium-low heat for 3 minutes each side until golden brown and cooked through.
Dust with a little sugar and serve warm.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 2 cakes.
Food safety: wash hands after handling raw egg.

recipes.title: Cheddar and Mustard Cheese Twists
recipes.summary: Crisp puff pastry twists with sharp cheddar, mustard and poppy-free sesame.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C fan (220°C conventional). Spread one side of each pastry sheet with the mustard.
Scatter over the cheddar, fold in half and press down, then cut into 12 strips.
Twist each strip and lay on lined trays, pressing the ends down.
Brush with the egg, scatter with sesame seeds and bake for 15 minutes until puffed and golden.
Cool for 5 minutes so the cheese sets before eating.
notes: Snack. Per serving: 4 twists.
Food safety: wash hands after handling raw egg.

recipes.title: Golden Oat Flapjacks
recipes.summary: Chewy British oat bars with butter and golden syrup, cut into squares.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C fan (180°C conventional) and line a 20cm square tin.
Melt the butter, sugar and golden syrup together over low heat, stirring until smooth.
Stir in the oats, sultanas and salt until fully coated.
Press firmly into the tin and bake for 25 minutes until golden at the edges but still soft in the middle.
Cool completely in the tin, about 1 hour, then cut into 12 bars.
notes: Plus 1 hour cooling.
Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 1 bar.

recipes.title: Apple Cinnamon Muffins
recipes.summary: Tender muffins studded with apple and a cinnamon sugar crust.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C fan (200°C conventional) and line a 6-hole muffin tin.
Whisk the oil, egg and milk, then fold in the flour, sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon until just combined.
Fold in the apple and divide between the holes.
Sprinkle with the remaining cinnamon and bake for 22 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 5 minutes.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 1 muffin.
Food safety: wash hands after handling raw egg.

recipes.title: Honey Sesame Pasteli
recipes.summary: Crunchy Greek sesame and honey bars that set hard as they cool.
steps: Toast the sesame seeds in a dry pan for 4 minutes until golden, then tip out.
Simmer the honey and lemon juice in the pan over medium heat for 5 minutes until it reaches a bubbling, thick caramel.
Stir in the sesame seeds and salt for 30 seconds until fully coated.
Press onto baking paper in a rectangle about 1cm thick.
Cool for 20 minutes until set, then break or cut into 10 pieces.
notes: Plus 20 minutes setting.
Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: 1 piece.

recipes.title: Whipped Feta Dip with Pita Crisps
recipes.summary: Cloud-light feta and yoghurt dip with lemon and olive oil, served with crisp pita.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C fan (220°C conventional). Cut the pita into 16 triangles and toss with 1 tbsp oil.
Bake the pita for 8 minutes until golden and crisp.
Blend the feta, yoghurt, lemon juice, garlic and remaining oil for 2 minutes until completely smooth.
Spoon into a bowl and make a swirl on top.
Serve with the pita crisps while they are still warm.
notes: Snack. Vegetarian. Per serving: a quarter of the dip with 4 crisps.

recipes.title: Beetroot Hummus with Veggie Sticks
recipes.summary: Vivid pink hummus with tahini and lemon, served with crunchy carrot and cucumber sticks.
steps: Drain the beetroot and chickpeas.
Blend the beetroot, chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, oil, cumin and salt for 3 minutes until completely smooth, scraping down the sides.
Taste and add more lemon or salt if needed.
Spoon into a bowl and drizzle with a little extra oil.
Serve with the carrot and cucumber sticks.
notes: Snack. Vegan. Per serving: a sixth of the dip with sticks.

recipes.title: White Bean and Rosemary Dip
recipes.summary: A creamy cannellini dip with lemon and rosemary, served with raw vegetable dippers.
steps: Blend the beans, oil, lemon juice, garlic, rosemary and salt for 2 minutes until completely smooth.
Add a splash of water if too thick.
Spoon into a bowl and drizzle with a little oil.
Taste and add more lemon or salt if needed.
Serve with the carrot sticks and capsicum strips.
notes: Snack. Vegan. Per serving: a quarter of the dip with veg.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon and Dill Dip
recipes.summary: Creamy smoked salmon and cream cheese dip with dill and lemon, served with cucumber rounds.
steps: Chop the smoked salmon finely.
Beat the cream cheese, yoghurt and lemon juice until smooth.
Fold in the salmon, dill and pepper until evenly combined.
Chill for 30 minutes until firm.
Serve with the cucumber rounds.
notes: Plus 30 minutes chilling.
Snack. Per serving: a quarter of the dip with cucumber.
Food safety: keep smoked salmon below 5°C, eat within 2 days of opening, and avoid it if pregnant or immunocompromised.

recipes.title: Smoky Paprika Almonds
recipes.summary: Roasted almonds tossed with smoked paprika, garlic and sea salt.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C fan (180°C conventional).
Toss the almonds with the oil, paprika, garlic powder and salt.
Spread on a tray and roast for 12 minutes until fragrant and a shade darker.
Cool for 10 minutes so they crisp.
Store in an airtight jar for up to 2 weeks.
notes: Snack. Vegan. Per serving: a small handful, about 30g.

recipes.title: Egg and Veggie Protein Mini Frittatas
recipes.summary: High-protein egg bites with spinach, capsicum and a little cheddar, baked in a muffin tin.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C fan (200°C conventional) and grease a 6-hole muffin tin.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper.
Divide the spinach, capsicum and cheddar between the holes and pour over the egg.
Bake for 18 minutes until puffed, set in the middle and golden.
Cool for 5 minutes in the tin before lifting out.
notes: Snack. Per serving: 1 frittata (about 9g protein).
Food safety: cook eggs until fully set, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.

recipes.title: Chaat Masala Roasted Chickpeas
recipes.summary: Crunchy oven-roasted chickpeas with a tangy spiced finish.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C fan (220°C conventional).
Drain the chickpeas and dry them thoroughly in a tea towel.
Toss with the oil and roast on a tray for 30 minutes, shaking twice, until crisp and golden.
Toss with the cumin, amchur, chilli and salt while hot.
Cool for 10 minutes to crisp up further and eat the same day.
notes: Snack. Vegan. Per serving: about 3/4 cup.

recipes.title: Chilli Salt Edamame
recipes.summary: Steamed edamame pods tossed with flaky salt, chilli and lime.
steps: Boil the edamame in salted water for 5 minutes until the pods are bright green and the beans tender.
Drain well in a colander and shake off the excess water.
Toss with the salt and chilli while still steaming so the seasoning sticks.
Squeeze over the juice of the lime and toss again.
Serve warm, squeezing the beans from the pods straight into your mouth.
notes: Snack. Vegan. Per serving: a quarter of the pods.
